body:
## Summary

Nit-level findings from a full-codebase review. Each is small but real; grouping to keep tracker noise down.

### 1. `sendSetWorkspaceRoot` bypasses the single-flight dispatch queue (agent.ts:506-546)
Never calls `acquireDispatch`; attaches its own stdout handler (not registered in `activeDataHandler`); sends `type:'chat'` with `text:' '` and resolves on the **first done/error of any stream** (no messageId check; has a 15s timer). If a chat/slash stream is in flight: (a) a second `type:'chat'` payload is written to worker stdin mid-protocol (single in-flight protocol corrupted); (b) it consumes the unrelated request's `done` → premature resolve; (c) the `' '` chat triggers a wasted LLM round polluting the worker session; (d) `cancelGeneration` can't remove its listener. Called on every paper/patent write (panel.ts:1716). **Fix:** acquire the dispatch slot, check `msg.messageId`, register/cleanup via `activeDataHandler` — or add a dedicated `'set-workspace'` worker message type instead of reusing `'chat'`.

### 2. `coding_tools.ts:483-497, 512-514, 539-542` — spawnSync failures swallowed as "0 matches"
`grep_search`/`glob_files` never check `result.error`/`result.status`; a missing `rg` binary (ENOENT) or invalid regex (exit 2) returns `ok({matchCount: 0})` — the model can't distinguish "no matches" from "search failed". `ast_grep` checks `result.status !== 0` but a spawn error yields `status === null` → also "no matches". **Fix:** `if (result.error) return err(...)`; surface stderr on exit code >= 2.

### 3. `raw_facts_saver.ts:31-33` — Windows-illegal filename + uncapped name length
`facts_${safeName}_${timestamp}.json` uses a raw ISO timestamp containing `:` (illegal on Windows → `writeFileSync` throws → analysis fails), while `phase_writer` sanitizes `[:.]` → `-`. `technologyName` has no length cap (phase_writer slices to 80) → `ENAMETOOLONG`. **Fix:** same `replace(/[:.]/g,'-')` + `.slice(0,80)`.

### 4. `panel.ts:1108` — `/download` help text states the wrong output directory
Says PDFs are saved to `<workspace>/.trinno/papers/`, but the code (panel.ts:1135) saves to `path.join(wsRoot, '06_References')`. Users are told the wrong location. **Fix the text.**

### 5. Dead code
- `downloader.ts:275-340` `extractFileUrlsFromHtml` — unused (document_extractor's `extractUrlsFromHtml` is used instead); also carries the same `&` flaw (see issue #12)
- `worker.ts` `pendingSlashOutput` written (:483) never read; `syncSessionAfterCommand` (:1992-2038) never called; `currentSessionIdForCancel` written (:580, :1611, :1988) never read

### 6. Listener leaks
- `panel.ts` `resolveWebviewView` re-registration leaks `agentEvents` listeners (`TodoUpdate`/`GoalProgress`/`SubagentStatus` + `onDidChangeVisibility`) with no disposable; if the view is disposed and re-resolved, events postMessage N times (approvals are deduped, these are not). **Fix:** register once with a guard flag or track disposables.
- `worker.ts:1652` — `signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true })` per round, never removed on normal resolve; a cancel during a slash fires ALL leaked listeners. **Fix:** `removeEventListener` in a finally.

### 7. Smaller items
- `emit` queue saturation (worker.ts:236-244) drops `'done'`/`'error'` too — a full queue under stdout backpressure drops the final done → panel hang. Exempt done/error or drop-oldest.
- `racer.ts:89-98` — losing sources never canceled; late callbacks mutate settled state (`failures` array, spurious `fail` progress events post-settle). **Fix:** internal AbortController aborted in `finishNow`; gate callbacks on `settled`.
- `identifier.ts` — `https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00001` and pubmed URLs parse as `kind:'url'` → slow HTML-scrape path instead of the arxiv/pmid sources. **Fix:** add URL patterns before the `url` fallback.
- `filename.ts:17,33-36` — trailing dots not re-stripped after truncation (`Author (2020) aa..a..pdf`); `RESERVED_WIN` guard effectively dead; `dedupeFilename` TOCTOU (concurrent same-paper downloads overwrite).
- `panel.ts:650-675` deleteSessionById — see issue #9 (data loss, filed separately).
- `extension.ts:15` — `openTextDocument(...).then(...)` lacks `.catch` (unhandled promise).
title: Minor issues collection: sendSetWorkspaceRoot bypasses dispatch queue, coding_tools swallows spawn failures, raw_facts_saver Windows-illegal filenames, /download help text wrong dir, dead code, listener leaks
